notes: Website-review letter (no facility inspection, no FEI stated) finding that fecal microbiota transplant products sold as capsules/enema infusions are unapproved new drugs and unlicensed biological products under the PHS Act, marketed for uses beyond FDA's C. difficile enforcement-discretion policy; no specific branded product name is given, and C. difficile is discussed only as the treated indication, not as an organism found at a facility.
